speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to your consultation. I am Dr. Agent; since you are a newborn, I will need to rely on your parents' description of your symptoms and medical history to begin my assessment. What specific changes in your health, such as breathing difficulties, feeding issues, or skin discoloration, have you noticed since birth?

speaker: Patient
text: Newborn, female. The patient is a 3000-g (6.6-lb) female newborn delivered at term to a 23-year-old primigravida mother. The mother reports having had no prenatal care, and immunization records for the newborn are not available.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for the history. Given the lack of prenatal care and immunizations, I need to know if you have noticed any jaundice, poor feeding, or specific skin rashes on this newborn. Do you have access to a stethoscope to listen to her heart and lungs right now?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Continuous heart murmur. I also have Bluish macules on the skin that do not blanch with pressure, Cloudy lenses in both eyes noticed upon examination, Failure to pass auditory screening tests.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Congenital Rubella Syndrome. The combination of a continuous heart murmur (likely PDA), blueberry muffin rash (bluish non-blanching macules), and cataracts in a newborn with no immunizations is classic for this diagnosis.
